==About==

{{i|Blackberries}} can be Picked from a {{i|Blackberry Bush}}. Learning the [[Flowers & Berries]] Skill will allow you to Pick more Blackberries from each [[Bush]]. Blackberries can be stored a {{i|Berry Sack}}.
